column1: I, Bambarende Peduruge Shamika Anuradhi, Divisional Secretary of
the Division of Balapitiya in Galle District in terms of Section 33 of
the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) hereby give notice that the
sum of  Rupees One Thousand (Rs. 1000/-) being compensation for
the acquisition of the land described in the schedule below has been
deposited in under the Case No. A-349 of District Court of Balapitiya
to be drawn by the person entitled there to.
